## 2. Core Service Ecosystem

- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://growthbeacon.co.in/services/seo/): On-page keyword optimization, technical Core Web Vitals audit, Schema.org JSON-LD structured data implementation, local backlink acquisition, and keyword rank growth.
- [Google Search PPC Ads](https://growthbeacon.co.in/services/google-ads/): High-intent Google Search PPC ad campaigns, negative keyword management, conversion extension setup, landing page optimization, and target Cost-Per-Acquisition (CPA) tuning.
- [Meta Advertising (Facebook & Instagram Ads)](https://growthbeacon.co.in/services/meta-ads/): Demographic and interest-targeted Meta Ads, video creative production, Meta Pixel tracking, lookalike audience expansion, and high-ROAS lead generation funnels.
- [Google Business Profile & Local Maps Optimization](https://growthbeacon.co.in/services/google-business-profile-optimization/): Top 3 Google Maps local pack optimization, GMB audit, geotagged citation building, review automation, and local customer lead call tracking across Theni and South Tamil Nadu.
- [Custom Website Development](https://growthbeacon.co.in/services/website-development/): Custom high-speed mobile-first web engineering, W3C HTML5 compliance, glassmorphism design, e-commerce development (WooCommerce/Shopify), and custom CRM lead integration.
- [WhatsApp Marketing & Automation](https://growthbeacon.co.in/services/whatsapp-marketing/): Official WhatsApp Business API chatbots, automated lead response workflows, broadcast campaigns, and direct customer engagement systems.
